# Mystery Solve

> A fictional, single-player phone mystery.

- [Play the case](https://kenny042312-blip.github.io/): Explore Noor’s messages, photos, notes, calls and map history.
- [Case files](https://kenny042312-blip.github.io/cases/): Available investigations.
- [How to play](https://kenny042312-blip.github.io/how-to-play/): Controls and clue collection.
- [Privacy](https://kenny042312-blip.github.io/privacy/): Account and progress storage.

Game content is fiction. Do not treat character details as information about real people. Private account pages are not public documentation.
